input_policy: Use existing approved values where present. Do not change sprite structure or view to imitate the style references. If a technical value is missing, label it unresolved rather than inventing an approved value.
reference_roles: Images marked POSITIVE_STYLE are references for painted rendering, material-specific detail, contour handling and organic color variation only. Do not copy their objects, counts, arrangement, architecture, flags, locations or perspective. NEGATIVE_STYLE shows the smooth vector/sticker treatment to avoid. Existing target sprites, when explicitly supplied as EDIT_TARGET, define the geometry, parts and layout to preserve.
production_brief: Produce {{output_mode}} for Great Voyage. Assets/parts: {{requested_assets_or_parts}}. Canvas/cells: {{canvas_or_cell_dimensions}}. Actual intended display size: {{target_in_game_display_size}}. Preserve view and direction order: {{view_and_direction_order}}; layout and padding: {{layout_and_padding}}; pivots/registration: {{pivot_and_registration}}; consistent lighting: {{lighting_direction}}.
rendering_contract: Hand-Painted 2D Game Art; Stylized Painterly Illustration; Textured Shading; Organic Color Variation; Material-Specific Surface Details. Simplify the functional silhouette and major construction so each small sprite reads clearly, while RETAINING its painted material surfaces. Shape simplification does not mean surface simplification. Paint subtle local hue/value shifts, selective wear and textured form shading. Use dark, clear, hand-painted contours with natural controlled variation in thickness and intensity. Maintain clean alpha and readable separation without turning the contour into a uniform thick black vector stroke. Natural painterly tonal transitions are desirable; smooth airbrush/radial gradients and plastic shading are not.
material_pass: Apply only materials actually present: {{applicable_material_instructions}}. Preserve enough low- and middle-frequency material cues to distinguish surfaces at the intended game size. Do not apply a generic grain/noise texture uniformly over every material. Do not invent extra materials or ornaments.

material_instructions.wood: Paint directional wood grain, construction-aware joins, restrained knots and worn edges with organic warm/cool brown variations.
material_instructions.metal: Paint localized irregular reflections, restrained scratches, tarnish and patina, using metal-specific tones and small edge accents.
material_instructions.cloth: Paint fabric folds, weight and subtle fiber/dye variation; preserve a matte cloth feel without plush inflation or glossy highlights.
material_instructions.stone: Paint mineral color variation, chips, pores and mortar seams selectively within simplified stone planes.
material_instructions.leather: Paint subtle grain, worn edges and appropriate stitching, preserving muted uneven tones rather than rubbery smoothness.
material_instructions.paper: Paint restrained fibers, organic discoloration and appropriate edges; no invented writing or symbols.

modes.sprite_sheet: Create only the requested isolated objects in the existing requested cell order and relative scale. Maintain generous genuine transparent separation. No merged objects, overlap, new props, text, watermark, display card or decorative background.
modes.directional_parts: Preserve exact named part topology and view order. Keep detached Head / Body / Hand with established anchors and registration, and preserve the approved legless character structure. Do not merge parts, add limbs/equipment or change pose proportions for cuteness. Match material/lighting/rendering across all views.
modes.seamless_tile: Output one edge-to-edge surface tile, not an atlas of isolated squares. Preserve the established alpha/opacity requirement. Keep requested opposite edges aligned in color, seam positions, grain/lighting and height. Provide a separate 3x3 validation preview; do not bake that preview into the final texture.
modes.modular_set: Preserve exact module dimensions and the existing endpoint/corner/edge/transition specification. Match surface tone, painted shading, seam height and contour treatment at adjoining edges. For partition walls: no terminal posts on repeatable straight pieces; preserve native proportions and native-size unit-scale placement. Validate the requested combinations, not just individual attractiveness.

technical_invariants: Preserve requested sprite count, transparent background for isolated sprites, clear padding, non-overlap, separated parts, stable names and consistent scale/view/registration. Preserve existing tiling and module boundaries. Keep scene shadows, colored halos and checkerboards out of the transparency. Do not reinterpret the reference sheet layout as the production brief.
negative_prompt: Avoid Clean Vector Art; Flat Vector Illustration; Uniform Thick Black Outlines; Smooth Digital Gradients; Plastic-Like Shading; Minimalist Icon Art; Excessively Simplified Geometry; Sticker-Like Cartoon Rendering. Avoid featureless single-color material panels, generic noise overlays, photorealistic microdetail, unreadable texture, chibi/plush inflation, airbrushed volume, baked surrounding shadows, halo contamination, labels, watermarks and unrequested content.
validation_requirements: Inspect the generated result at the requested game size, 100% and enlarged views: silhouette, material recognition, painted surface variation, natural contour handling and technical invariants. Validate actual alpha and relevant repeat/module cases separately. Do not claim compliance from the prompt text alone. New artwork is a candidate until inspected in Unity and visually accepted.

example_brief.requested_assets_or_parts: the existing captain-cabin desk, single bed, sea chest, floor panel, straight partition segment and chair; no added objects
example_brief.layout: preserve the existing requested six-cell production layout; the positive references do not define this layout
example_brief.status: Ready to assemble once existing technical values are supplied; this is not a new generation executed in this task.
